faq.q1q: Who can participate in a Yatra organized by the Ashram?
faq.q1a: All devotees are welcome to join our Sacred Yatras regardless of age or background. We encourage families, individuals, and groups to participate. Every Yatra is conducted under Gurudev Ji's blessings with an emphasis on devotion, discipline, and community.
faq.q2q: How do I register for an upcoming Yatra?
faq.q2a: You can register by visiting the Ashram office at Palaskhed Sapkal, contacting our volunteers via phone, or by creating an account on our website. Once registration opens for a specific Yatra, announcements are made through our social media channels and at the Ashram during daily satsang.
faq.q3a: New Yatras are announced during special occasions, festivals, and through the Ashram's official communication channels. We recommend following our Facebook page and YouTube channel for the latest updates. Announcements are also made during daily evening satsang at the Ashram.
faq.q4q: What should I carry for a Yatra?
faq.q4a: We recommend carrying comfortable clothing suitable for temple visits, personal medications, a copy of your Aadhaar card, warm clothing for hill station Yatras, and personal hygiene items. A detailed packing guide is shared with all registered participants before departure.
faq.q5q: Are meals included during the Yatra?
faq.q5a: Yes. Pure Sattvic vegetarian meals are arranged throughout the Yatra. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are provided. The meals are prepared with care following the principles of Annadan (sacred food offering). Special dietary needs can be communicated during registration.
faq.q6q: Is medical assistance available during Yatras?
faq.q6a: Yes. A basic first-aid kit and common medicines are always carried by our seva volunteers. For Yatras to remote or high-altitude locations, we coordinate with local medical facilities. Devotees with pre-existing health conditions are advised to carry their own prescribed medications and inform us during registration.
faq.q7q: Can I visit the Ashram without joining a Yatra?
faq.q7a: Absolutely. माँ वैष्णवी टूरिज़्म at Palaskhed Sapkal welcomes all visitors and devotees throughout the year. You can attend daily satsang, Gita Path, Haripath, participate in Annadan seva, and seek darshan during regular visiting hours.
faq.q8q: What are the Darshan timings at the Ashram?
faq.q8a: Morning session is from 04:30 AM to 01:00 PM and evening session is from 04:30 PM to 09:00 PM. Kakda Aarti begins at 04:00 AM, Daily Morning Aarti at 06:00 AM, Haripath at 06:00 PM, and Gita Path at 08:00 PM. Timings may vary during special occasions and festivals.
faq.q9q: Is accommodation available at the Ashram?
faq.q9a: Limited accommodation is available for devotees within the Ashram premises. Rooms are allocated on a priority basis for elderly devotees and those traveling for seva purposes. Accommodation must be arranged in advance by contacting the Ashram office. Nearby hotels in Chikhli town are also available.
faq.q10q: What kind of accommodation is provided during Yatras?
faq.q10a: Accommodation varies based on the destination and type of Yatra. We arrange Dharmashalas, guest houses, and ashram stays wherever possible. Air-conditioned accommodations are provided for premium packages. Details are shared with registered participants in the Yatra itinerary document.
faq.q11q: How can I make a donation to the Ashram?
faq.q11a: Donations can be made directly at the Ashram office during visiting hours. Bank transfer details are available upon request by contacting our office. For online donations, please reach out to us via email or phone. All donations are used for Annadan, education, medical seva, and maintenance of the Ashram premises.
faq.q12q: Is there a tax benefit for donating to the Ashram?
faq.q12a: Swami Harichaitanya Shanti Ashram Trust is a registered charitable trust. Donations to registered charitable trusts may be eligible for tax exemptions under applicable income tax laws. We recommend consulting your tax advisor for specific guidance. Donation receipts are provided upon request.
faq.q13q: How can I volunteer for Ashram activities?
faq.q13a: We warmly welcome volunteers for Annadan seva, Yatra support, administrative work, and social service activities. Please contact us via phone or email to express your interest. Volunteers from all backgrounds are accepted, and specific training or orientation will be provided based on the type of seva chosen.
faq.q14q: How can I contact the Ashram for Yatra inquiries?
faq.q14a: You can reach us at +91 9158740007 or +91 9834151577. Email inquiries can be sent to info@shrigurudevashram.org or info@shantiashramtrust.org. Our office is open during Ashram visiting hours. You can also fill out the contact form on this website and we will respond within 24–48 hours.
